rv.q: Dinosaur World Live has a genuine, up-close charm and is a perfect child-distractor for the remainder of the summer holidays.
Dinosaur World Live delivers an immersive family experience which celebrates imagination, learning and world class puppetry.
Built around those astonishing puppets, Dinosaur World Live is a fabulous show for children, especially three to nine-year-olds.
A family-friendly show for little ones, grandparents and everyone in between.
It’s a fun show for all young dinosaur enthusiasts, and the skill with which the creatures are portrayed makes it an entertaining experience for the adults who take them there.

The exceptional puppets are the creation of Max Humphries. His detailed designs — including less commonly depicted dinosaurs with bushy feathers — along with some of Miranda's science-based insights, gently enrich children's knowledge about these prehistoric creatures without turning the experience into a dry museum lecture.

cn.t: Critics praise the impressive, life-like dinosaur puppetry that thrills young audiences, though note it's more an interactive demonstration than a traditional narrative show. The T-Rex earns particular acclaim in this family-friendly prehistoric adventure.
